purpose: Describe an instinctive response in a sudden moment.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
とっさに + quick action / realization
Startled by a noise, I instinctively turned around.
I caught the falling plate in a split second.
When asked, I could not come up with an answer on the spot.
formation: とっさに + quick action / realization
restrictions: Often involves little time for deliberate thought.
mistake: It is more immediate and reflexive than ordinary すぐに.
